purpose: Prevent reuse or rescue of already-covered V19 and Challenger C1 structures
prohibited_inputs: Challenger C1 entry inputs, wave states, ranks, candidates, trades, runtime or Discord state
V10/V17/V18/V19 signal and outcome ledgers as entry-generation inputs

covered_formula_families.static_description: E40 selected direction AND direction-specific rank >= 0.90 AND causal IMPULSE_EARLY AND first eligible event per episode
E40 selected direction AND chosen rank < 0.90 AND causal IMPULSE_LATE or CORRECTION_EARLY AND transition onset

prohibited_relations: use V19 or C1 as filter, ensemble, priority, fallback or confirmation
select a C1 rank band after observing its reported outcomes
reuse V19 or C1 TP/SL solely because their retrospective results were favorable
allowed_reference_use: Read frozen written contracts to identify already-covered structural concepts
After a GU1 formula is frozen, perform post-hoc overlap and additivity audit without changing GU1 entries
required_independence_test: Every GU1 entry must be reproducible from raw closed candles and GU1 code only
